label: lexeme reference has sense with name type?
description: Fetches the lexeme behind a Wikidata lexeme reference and returns true if any of its senses has a 'name type' (P14792) statement with the given item as value. Intended as the predicate for filtering a list of lexeme references (for example the output of Z6830) down to, say, toponyms or solfège syllables, so that only references travel through the filter.
summary: New function: lexeme reference has sense with name type?
